hero.headline: From Local Weather to Better Farm Decisions
hero.description: GramSankalpa combines localized weather, satellite insights, field indicators, and AI-powered crop guidance to help farmers plan sowing, irrigation, spraying, harvesting, and other farm activities.

features.headline: From Data to Farm Decisions
features.subheadline: Weather, satellite intelligence, and AI work together to turn complex agricultural data into practical decisions.

item1.title: Field Intelligence
item1.desc: Use satellite and geospatial data to understand vegetation health, water conditions, and changes across local farming areas.

item2.title: Crop Health Signals
item2.desc: Track NDVI, NDWI, land surface temperature, rainfall, and vegetation trends to understand changing crop and field conditions.

item3.title: Weather Risk Alerts
item3.desc: Identify upcoming heat, heavy rainfall, dry spells, and other weather conditions that could affect farm operations.

item4.title: AI Farm Recommendations
item4.desc: Turn weather, crop, and field information into practical recommendations for sowing, irrigation, spraying, and harvesting.

item5.title: Season & Historical Insights
item5.desc: Compare historical weather and vegetation patterns to understand seasonal changes and support better farm planning.

item6.title: Farmer-Ready Reports
item6.desc: Generate simple, actionable reports combining local weather, field indicators, crop guidance, and identified risks.

howItWorks.headline: From Local Data to Farm Action
howItWorks.subheadline: GramSankalpa brings together local weather, satellite signals, and AI to turn complex agricultural data into practical decisions.

step1.title: Select Your Location
step1.desc: Choose a village or farming region to build a localized view of its weather and agricultural conditions.

step2.title: Understand Local Conditions
step2.desc: Combine local weather with rainfall, temperature, vegetation, and other available environmental signals.

step3.title: Analyze the Field
step3.desc: Use satellite and geospatial indicators such as NDVI, NDWI, and land surface temperature to understand field conditions.

step4.title: Generate AI Guidance
step4.desc: AI combines the available signals to generate practical guidance for crops, weather risks, and upcoming farm activities.

step5.title: Take Action
step5.desc: View recommendations through the dashboard and generate a clear report for planning and decision-making.

technology.headline: Technology Behind the Intelligence
technology.subheadline: Built with modern weather, geospatial, cloud, and AI technologies to transform agricultural data into useful farm insights.
